title: Service call: address change, no sale

lines.t: Good afternoon, this is Neha from Suraksha Life customer service. Am I speaking with Mr Fernandes?
Yes. I want to change my address on the policy.
Sure. For security, please confirm your policy number and date of birth.
Policy number ST four five nine one two, born second March nineteen seventy nine.
Thank you, verified. What is the new address?
Flat twelve, Lake View Apartments, Pune.
Shall I update this as your correspondence address on the policy?
Done. You will get a confirmation message within a day. Anything else?
